candidates.requirement: An injected allocation failure during XInclude processing must satisfy the target's existing check that xmlXIncludeGetLastError reports XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY.
candidates.target_route: A valid main document containing a nonlocal xi:include reaches ProcessNode, DoProcess, ExpandNode, AddNode, and NewRef. Set the input's allocation limit to the allocation number of NewRef's xmlMalloc; pad an unused entity so the modulo permits that finite limit.
candidates.failure_condition: NewRef's xmlMalloc returns NULL and marks fuzzAllocFailed. The replacement xmlXIncludeErrMemory updates a global error but does not set the XInclude context's errNo. NewRef returns NULL; the target's existing allocation-failure check then aborts.
candidates.alternative_paths: The failed reference is never loaded, so the fallback/error path in LoadNode cannot set this context's errNo. ResetMallocFailed clears only the failure flag before processing, and the target reads the context error number rather than the global error.

candidates.requirement: The target's XInclude context processing must be able to reach the supported per-context structured error callback behavior.
candidates.target_route: A valid XML document with a namespaced xi:include whose href has no supplied entity reaches an XInclude error through ProcessNode. The supported setup installs a callback with xmlXIncludeSetErrorHandler before processing.
candidates.failure_condition: The complete old entry creates and processes the context without calling the setter. Its context handler remains NULL, so no input can exercise dispatch to a per-context callback.
candidates.alternative_paths: The target installs only a generic global error function. Structured error dispatch uses the context handler when set; that generic function cannot establish the per-context callback state.
